method: Requirement-level evidence is recorded only where a current OPEN source was inspected closely enough to support a conservative coverage judgement. Unreviewed requirements remain pending in AQA-PSYCHOLOGY-7182-SCOPE.json.

statusDefinitions.covered_candidate: Open reusable sources appear sufficient to supply the underlying subject knowledge for this named requirement; final Foundation transformation/quality is not yet asserted.
statusDefinitions.partial: Open reusable sources support material parts of the named requirement but at least one AQA-named element still needs targeted evidence or original bridge content.
statusDefinitions.gap: No adequate accepted reusable source has yet been found for the named requirement.
statusDefinitions.uncertain: A plausible source exists but rights or substantive sufficiency has not been resolved.
